_comment: Model asset manifest - the model binaries are NOT in this repository (license gate). Place each file at its target_path (relative to the voice_module root) and verify sha256 before first start. If a required model is missing the service refuses to start loudly (see README Troubleshooting); it never degrades silently.

models.name: firefly-chinese.pth
models.acquisition: Download from https://huggingface.co/Waterwzy/RVC-firefly-finetuning (pth + index must come from the same repo). The character voice is (c) HoYoverse / miHoYo - AGPL-3.0 applies to the weights and the voice derives from a copyrighted game character: do NOT re-upload to any git hosting.

models.name: firefly-chinese_v2.index
models.acquisition: Same repository as the .pth - always fetch the pair together.

models.name: hubert_base.pt
models.license: weights distributed with the RVC project (code MIT); no standalone weight license
models.acquisition: Download hubert_base.pt from the official RVC assets at https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI.

models.name: rmvpe.pt
models.license: weights distributed with the RVC project (code MIT); no standalone weight license
models.acquisition: Download rmvpe.pt from the official RVC assets at https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI.

models.name: reference_audio (examples/*.wav)
models.acquisition: Not required to run the service. The inference pipeline never reads these files.
